[4:55PM] #LagosAbeokutaExpress #Dopemu #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is good as you leave Ile-Zik inwards Mangoro, Cement, Saw Mill approaching MRS from where it starts to get a bit slow all the way to Dopemu underneath the bridge.

Traffic on the Dopemu bridge is good as well.

Moving to Akowonjo Roundabout as well as Shasha Roundabout is good.

Our Men are strategically positioned to ensure traffic is good.
